scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node --import tsx scripts/build.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests examples docs README.md *.json *.jsonc *.ts .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests examples docs README.md *.json *.jsonc *.ts .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.setup: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/setup.ts
scripts.package:extension: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/extension-evidence.ts
